name: boss-pre-setup
description:
GETS YOUR COMPUTER READY - this is the first thing you do. It does NOT install your operating system; that comes later, once your access is set up.

To activate, type in this command: set up my computer

What it does: sets up what your Claude is allowed to do on this computer so it stops asking you about every step; checks what is already installed; puts Git and the GitHub tool in place without ever needing your computer password; walks you through the one sign-in only you can do; then gives you your GitHub username and a short form to fill in so we can get your system over to you.

You will never be asked to open a terminal or type a command. Takes about 10-15 minutes.
